name: 16mm-noir
label: Black and white 16mm
_note: 16mm's stock and grain, noir's light and palette. Combining two presets by overriding field-by-field does not work — 16mm wants warm fading stock and noir wants no colour at all — so the fields are chosen one at a time.
render: photographic, black and white 16mm film stock, visible grain, gate weave, halation around highlights
lens: 25mm spherical, deep focus, locked-off or slow dolly, occasional focus breathing
lighting: single hard source, venetian-blind shadows, crushed blacks, blown practicals with halation
palette: black and white only, milky blacks from the stock, no colour anywhere in frame
negative: colour, pastel, soft even lighting, modern digital clarity, noise reduction, HDR, stabilised smoothness
